nodes.label: Viewer Markup Template (ui.html)
nodes.rationale: Nothing here carries an id because a document can hold the template many times (createViewer parses it into a div.sse-viewer per instance); every class carries the sse- prefix so host page styles cannot collide, and ui.ts looks elements up by 'sse-' + name under the instance root; layering is by order back to front so nothing needs a z-index.
